description: Colour literals intentionally left in colors.css, styles/dashboard/*.css and styles/brain-builder.css. Matching is by (file, normalized literal). Black shadows (X6) are exempt in the scanner and are not listed. count = exact number of occurrences allowed in that file.

legend.X2: Contract 13 X2: published artifacts and documents hosted in frames (.brief-kit, brief/pricing/audit iframes)
legend.X5: Contract 13 X5: brand imagery and media; video/poster letterbox backdrops
legend.X6: Contract 13 X6: mode-agnostic shadows and fixed data-semantic / categorical colours (chips, charts, status one-offs, traffic-light dots)
legend.X11: Contract 13 X11: Radix yellow scale in colors.css, no consumers
legend.X13: Contract 13 X13: animation mechanics (comet ring heads, alpha masks) and specular sheens / glows over the vivid accent gradient
legend.WS5-DARK: WS5: surfaces that are dark by design in both modes (destructive/rename dialogs, Market-brief config console, dark scrims over imagery)
legend.WS5-FIXED: WS5: white text on a fill that is itself a fixed literal or fixed-colour token, so the pair does not change per mode
legend.WS5-PAPER: WS5: the Market Signals IN BRIEF paper preview, a printed-page look that stays light in both modes
legend.WS5-LEFT: WS5: one-off neutrals with no exact theme role; left literal to keep the light baseline identical (designer follow-up)
